rubric.pass: The section 1 mini-project meets Pass on every criterion.
rubric.strong: It meets Strong on gradient correctness and on saved values, and one command runs every differential check.

rubric.pass: One small CNN, recurrent, VAE or attention model trains in the section 2 trainer with config and split provenance, tiny-set and shuffled-label controls, complete checkpoint state and a stated resume-equivalence result.
rubric.strong: Resume is exact on CPU, and a fresh clone reproduces the reported metrics within the stated tolerance.

rubric.pass: Three seeded-fault postmortems, one each for objective or data, numerical or state, and performance or compile behavior, each with hypotheses, a discriminating control, repair, regression guard, measured evidence and one limitation.
rubric.strong: Each regression guard fails on its fault and passes on its repair in one test command.

rubric.pass: A README lists the commands that rebuild each artifact.
rubric.strong: One script rebuilds every reported number on a CPU or a free notebook GPU, with its run time stated.

rubric.pass: Each artifact states what its compact model and data cannot show.
rubric.strong: Each limit names the later stage or track that addresses it.
